notes.zh: 修复多文件 ID 与名称文字挤满画面的问题；批量加载改为整批数量进度，并采用浅蓝进度、深蓝百分比标签与蓝白条纹。网页和 App 内网页同步生效；提供同版本完整 APK。
notes.en: Fix overflowing multi-file IDs and names. Show whole-batch item-count progress with a light-blue fill, dark-blue percentage badge and blue/white stripes. Applies to browser viewers and their App web pages; includes a matching complete APK.
